results.smart: FS3 is a new Rust-based version of Flowspace that uses Tree-sitter for direct AST parsing and centralizes file data and embeddings in PostgreSQL with vector support, rather than a source graph. It should represent worktrees as Git-aware file trees, diffing changed files by commit IDs instead of copying and rescanning the main graph, while splitting files into embeddable summaries of files and their methods or components using local or online models with parallel processing.
